ValidationRule.description: Branding return cases must name the asset being returned and its condition. Enforced here as well as in the UI so a data loader or API insert cannot skip them. Vendor is deliberately excluded - it is captured at Mahesh's approval, not at submission.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Case_Type__r.Name = 'Branding & Marketing Asset transfer Request', OR( ISBLANK(Branding_Asset__c), ISPICKVAL(Condition__c, '') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select the Branding Asset being returned and its Condition.
